Seamless tileable module of a Chinese riverside residential tower facade at night, Yichang, Hubei. Exactly four floors by four window bays, so one tile represents about 13 m wide by 13 m tall. Pale grey-beige painted concrete and small ceramic tiles, dark aluminium sliding windows, projecting concrete balconies with laundry poles and split air-conditioner units, security grilles on some windows. About one third of the windows are lit, mostly cool white with a few warm amber; the rest are dark with faint reflections. Subtle rain streaks, grime under sills, no exterior light fixtures on the wall. No text, no signage, no shop names, no people, no bridge, no landscape, no sky. Flat orthographic elevation, even diffuse light, photorealistic, high detail, tileable in both directions, muted teal-and-amber night grade, ordinary realistic Chinese apartment building, not a luxury tower.
